name: Monofor Monopam
summary: Monopam is Monofor's privileged access product. Monofor licenses it by concurrent privileged session, not per target, vault or feature. It lists an encrypted vault, session recording and just-in-time access with approvals. The page shows no Monopam price and sends buyers to sales.

facts.text: Monofor says buyers pay for concurrent privileged sessions, not per target, per vault or per feature.
Monopam lists an encrypted credential vault, session recording with video and keystrokes, and just-in-time access with approvals.
Monopam is one of three Monofor products. Monosign, from $4 per user per month, covers SSO, MFA and user provisioning, and Monosync covers identity governance.

plans.name: Monopam
plans.notes: The page shows the label Per session and the button Talk to sales. The 30-day free trial is mentioned in the Every plan includes section, but the only Start free trial button sits under Monosign, so Monopam trial terms are unclear.
